title: Yummy Thai Rice Khanom Thai
description: Floral, crumbly Thai rice cookies with scallion accent, perfect for a cozy flexitarian dessert.
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine sticky rice flour, coconut milk, palm sugar, vanilla extract, soy sauce, salt, and baking soda until smooth batter forms.
Stir in chopped scallions and let the mixture rest for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Heat a comal over medium heat and lightly oil the surface with vegetable oil.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the comal, flattening them into thin rounds about 4 cm in diameter.
Cook each side until golden brown and crisp edges form, roughly 2 minutes per side.
Transfer cooked rings onto a paper towel to absorb excess oil.
Let the Khanom Thai cool to room temperature before serving.
Optional: Dust with toasted sesame seeds or a pinch of sugar before serving.
